queries.query: Lisala Democratic Republic of the Congo cadastral map land registry official; Lisala DRC cadastre parcel official
queries.result: Search found the official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs site, which lists Lisala as a cadastral/land circumscription, and the BIC cadastral platform. The BIC platform states that its digital parcel service is available only for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu; no Lisala parcel viewer or public geometry endpoint was found.

queries.query: Lisala République démocratique du Congo cadastre parcelles registre foncier officiel; circonscription foncière de Lisala
queries.result: La recherche a confirmé la circonscription foncière de Lisala dans la province de la Mongala. Le ministère décrit une procédure de recherche foncière nécessitant une demande et des références de bien; elle n'est pas une API publique de géométrie. Le BIC affiche une couverture de données limitée au Nord-Kivu et au Sud-Kivu.

freshResearch.nativeLanguageNote: French is the official administrative language used for the DRC land/cadastre sources; Lingala and other national-language routes were not needed after the first-party French service discovery was confirmed.

registryEvidence.custodian: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la République démocratique du Congo
registryEvidence.localScope: The official circumscription directory places Lisala and Bumba under Province de Mongala.
registryEvidence.sourceType: local registry/cadastre custodian and official procedure evidence; no public parcel geometry service evidenced

sourceAssessment.coverage: The public BIC landing page and its anonymous catalog_config response list available provinces as Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu only; Mongala/Lisala is outside the advertised digital coverage.
safeFieldsAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if later exposed

runtimeReadinessReason: A serial reviewer must independently qualify a real adapter. No anonymous Lisala parcel endpoint, schema, CRS, stable parcel identity, or bounded geometry response was available in this attempt.
uncertainty: Official local custodianship and a Lisala cadastral circumscription are evidenced, but the source pages do not publish a machine-readable parcel layer.
BIC coverage limits are evidence about that public pilot, not proof that no paper or restricted cadastral records exist in Lisala.
No exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, or login wall was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
